responsibility: Implements the main COBOL symbol table and much of the front end’s semantic object management. It allocates and extends the mapped symbol table, records source locations, maintains program/register/special/label maps, validates and updates fields, files, keys, and forward references, computes properties such as file status and type/value classification, and serves as the central repository of parsed COBOL entities consumed by later semantic checks and code generation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the symbol-table storage, maps, validation, and update/query behavior declared in symbols.h. Unlike the header, this .cc file contains the concrete semantic object management and mapped-table mechanics.
